author: FeministKill4
quote: **GTA 6 – A Woke, Feminized Disaster**This review concerns the Story Mode only. I have not played GTA Online and therefore cannot judge the online experience.After just two hours, I had enough. GTA 6 is an unbelievably boring, watered-down and woke disaster. A glorified Sims and relationship simulator disguised as Grand Theft Auto. Boring, feminized characters, lifeless dialogue, forgettable villains, tedious household errands, relationship bonuses and ridiculous everyday activities instead of the freedom, chaos, dark satire and brutal entertainment that made GTA legendary. Repairing houses, buying flowers and catering to your virtual girlfriend? Seriously? Rockstar seems to have replaced everything that made GTA great with feminist nonsense, ideological sanitization and mind-numbing relationship drama. The player freedom is crippled, the gameplay feels restrictive and the entire experience is painfully dull. Compared to GTA 4 and GTA 5, this is an embarrassing downgrade. The ridiculous hype and perfect review scores only make this circus more insulting. This isn't the evolution of GTA. It's the hollow, woke imitation of a once-great franchise. A creative disaster. Perhaps GTA Online can still redeem something, but I cannot judge it until I've played it.
